name: Smart Home
short_desc: Service: let your Wizard check and control your smart-home devices, like purifiers, vacuums, lights and plugs.
author: Home Assistant (Open Home Foundation); packaged by Humanity Labs
description: Unmodified Home Assistant, the open-source smart-home hub, running on your own box and set up for you. Open Smart Home, sign in to your device brand once, and your agent can check and control your devices: purifiers, vacuums, lights, plugs and sensors. It works with any brand Home Assistant supports. Camera video stays in the brand's own app. Unlocking doors or disarming alarms always needs your yes. Cloud-connected devices work from a server anywhere; devices that only talk on your home network (Zigbee, Bluetooth, local-only) need the box at home. Keep it on your private network (e.g. Tailscale).
